stem: A fixture layout has the desired average PPFD but a large coefficient of spatial variation across the canopy. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Average PPFD alone is insufficient; distribution uniformity should be improved or accounted for
The average guarantees every plant receives equal light
Uniformity is irrelevant if total fixture wattage is high
rationale: Averages can conceal high and low zones. Canopy performance and experimental interpretation depend on spatial distribution as well as average photon flux.
